issues.display_title: Issue #219: Public API Get Published Exhibitions for Viewer
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Public API Get Published Exhibitions for Viewer

Files Changed / Added

  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerPublishedExhibitions.go (action handler with pagination, room filtering, share string filtering, search, sorting, and user metadata)
  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerPublishedExhibitions_test.go (unit tests covering pagination, sorting, nil DB handling, and UUID exclusion verification)
  • src/controllers/v1/exhibitionController.go (controller mapping: GetViewerPublishedExhibitions)
  • src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes.go (route registration: viewers.Get("/exhibitions", controllers.GetViewerPublishedExhibitions))
  • src/routes/v1/route.go (added OPTIONS:/v1/viewers/* to JWT exclusion rules)
  • src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes_test.go (route integration tests verifying unauthenticated access and OPTIONS preflight)
  • api-collection/Villume GO/Viewers/Get Published Exhibitions for Viewer.yml (API collection request file)

Summary of Implementation

Implemented the public endpoint GET /v1/viewers/exhibitions for the Villume VR / Web viewer:

  • Public unauthenticated access: Accessible without JWT token, matching viewer client requirements.
  • Published virtual gallery filtering: Fetches exhibitions where deleted = false, published = true, and owner users.is_active = true.
  • Search: Case-insensitive substring matching across exhibitions.name, users.username, users.first_name, users.last_name, and concatenated full name.
  • Room Template Filter: Matches room model name (exhibitions.model_name) or model type (exhibitions.model_type).
  • Share String Filter: Direct lookup by share_string.
  • Sorting: Multi-column sorting supporting recently_published (default), name_a_z, and name_z_a.
  • UUID exclusion: Omitted internal database id (UUID) from response payload as instructed, ensuring downstream integrations rely cleanly on share_string and username.

Detailed Changes

1. Action Handler (src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerPublishedExhibitions.go)

  • Query Parsing & Defaults:
    • page: default 1, validated > 0.
    • limit: default 12, max 100.
    • offset = (page - 1) * limit.
  • Base Query: 
    baseQuery := config.DB.WithContext(c.Context()).
    Model(&models.Exhibition{}).
    Joins("JOIN users ON users.id = exhibitions.user_id").
    Where("exhibitions.deleted = ?", false).
    Where("exhibitions.published = ?", true).
    Where("users.is_active = ?", true)
  • Filter Clauses:
    • By share_string: baseQuery.Where("exhibitions.share_string = ?", shareString)
    • By room: baseQuery.Where("(exhibitions.model_name ILIKE ? OR exhibitions.model_type ILIKE ?)", roomLike, roomLike)
    • By search: 
      baseQuery.Where(
    "(exhibitions.name ILIKE ? OR users.username ILIKE ? OR users.first_name ILIKE ? OR users.last_name ILIKE ? OR CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) ILIKE ?)",
    searchLike, searchLike, searchLike, searchLike, searchLike,
)
  • Sorting (ResolveViewerExhibitionOrder):
    • recently_published (default): exhibitions.published_date DESC NULLS LAST, exhibitions.created_at DESC, exhibitions.id DESC
    • name_a_z: exhibitions.name ASC, exhibitions.id ASC
    • name_z_a: exhibitions.name DESC, exhibitions.id DESC
  • Response Construction:
    Constructs ViewerPublishedExhibitionItem omitting id: 
    type ViewerPublishedExhibitionItem struct {
    Name        string               `json:"name"`
    Thumbnail   string               `json:"thumbnail"`
    ShareString string               `json:"share_string"`
    RoomName    string               `json:"room_name"`
    ModelType   string               `json:"model_type"`
    User        ViewerExhibitionUser `json:"user"`
}

2. Route Configuration (src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes.go)

viewers := r.Group("/viewers")
viewers.Get("/exhibitions", controllers.GetViewerPublishedExhibitions)
viewers.Get("/artists", controllers.GetViewerArtists)
...
viewers.Get("/exhibitions/:sid", controllers.GetExhibitionViewer)

Registered before parameterized /:sid to ensure exact match precedence.

3. API Collection

Added api-collection/Villume GO/Viewers/Get Published Exhibitions for Viewer.yml.

API Usage & Examples (How to Use)

1. Default Listing (Explore Galleries)

Fetch the first page of 12 published exhibitions, sorted by most recently published:

curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/exhibitions?page=1&limit=12"

2. Filter by Room Template

Filter galleries using a specific 3D room template (e.g., Alexandria):

curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/exhibitions?room=Alexandria&page=1&limit=12"

3. Search by Gallery Name or Artist Name

Search galleries matching a title keyword or artist name/username:

curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/exhibitions?search=Dark%20Valleys"

4. Filter by Specific Share String

Retrieve a specific gallery card by its public share string:

curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/exhibitions?share_string=abc123xyz"

5. Custom Sorting (Name A-Z / Name Z-A)

# Sort alphabetical A-Z
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/exhibitions?sort=name_a_z&page=1&limit=12"

# Sort alphabetical Z-A
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/exhibitions?sort=name_z_a&page=1&limit=12"

6. Example JSON Response

{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Success",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "name": "Dark Valleys",
        "thumbnail": "ALEXANDRIA/thumbnail.png",
        "share_string": "abc123xyz",
        "room_name": "Alexandria",
        "model_type": "Alexandria",
        "user": {
          "username": "georg_c2",
          "first_name": "Georg",
          "last_name": "Katstaller",
          "avatar": "https://villume.com/avatar.png"
        }
      }
    ],
    "total_count": 29,
    "total_pages": 3,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 12
  }
}

7. Downstream Client Integration Flow

When a user interacts with a gallery item in the Unity / Web frontend:

  1. Enter 3D Gallery: Use item.share_string to call GET /v1/viewers/json/:share_string and GET /v1/exhibitions/model?sid=:share_string.
  2. View Artist Profile: Use item.user.username to call GET /v1/users/:username or GET /v1/viewers/:username/exhibitions?type=outside.
  3. No database UUID is required at any point in the viewer flow.

Verification & Tests

Automated Tests

  1. src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerPublishedExhibitions_test.go:
    • TestParseViewerPagination: Tests pagination bounds, invalid inputs, and defaults.
    • TestResolveViewerExhibitionOrder: Verifies sorting clauses for all options.
    • TestGetViewerPublishedExhibitions_NilDB: Verifies graceful failure when database is unavailable.
    • TestViewerPublishedExhibitionItem_NoUUIDInJSON: Explicitly asserts that id and uuid are not serialized in the response JSON.
  2. src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes_test.go:
    • TestViewerRoutesArePublic: Verifies GET /v1/viewers/exhibitions does not require JWT authorization.
    • TestViewerRoutesOptionsPreflight: Verifies OPTIONS preflight requests succeed without auth.

Overview

Implement the public endpoint GET /v1/viewers/exhibitions to support the Explore Galleries main page and the Highlighted Galleries carousel for the Villume VR / Web viewer client (galleries.html).

The endpoint provides:

  1. Paginated virtual gallery listing (page and limit).
  2. Search by gallery name or artist name/username (?search=...).
  3. Room template filter (?room=...).
  4. Share string filter (?share_string=...).
  5. Multi-option sorting (recently_published, name_a_z, name_z_a).
  6. Gallery creator details (user.username, user.first_name, user.last_name, user.avatar).
  7. Excludes internal database UUIDs (id) as downstream viewer endpoints rely exclusively on share_string and username.

Requirements

  1. Public Access:
    • Endpoint is unauthenticated (no JWT token required).
    • Exempt from JWT middleware under /v1/viewers/*.
  2. Filtering & Visibility:
    • Only returns active, non-deleted, published galleries (published = true, deleted = false, users.is_active = true).
    • Supports ?share_string=... to filter by a specific gallery's share token.
    • Supports ?room=... to filter by room template name (matches model_name or model_type).
  3. Search:
    • Supports ?search=... performing case-insensitive matching across exhibitions.name, users.username, users.first_name, users.last_name, and concatenated full name.
  4. Sorting (?sort=...):
    • recently_published (default): exhibitions.published_date DESC NULLS LAST, exhibitions.created_at DESC, exhibitions.id DESC
    • name_a_z: exhibitions.name ASC, exhibitions.id ASC
    • name_z_a: exhibitions.name DESC, exhibitions.id DESC
  5. Pagination:
    • page: integer (default: 1, minimum: 1).
    • limit: integer (default: 12, max: 100).
    • Response includes total_count, total_pages, page, and limit.
  6. Data Contract:
    • items: Array of gallery objects containing name, thumbnail, share_string, room_name, model_type, and user object.
    • Does not expose database UUID (id), as VR and viewer client subsequent requests use share_string for scene loading and username for artist profiles.
    • Returns empty array [] (not null) when no records match.

Scope

  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerPublishedExhibitions.go (handler logic, filtering, sorting, pagination)
  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerPublishedExhibitions_test.go (unit tests)
  • src/controllers/v1/exhibitionController.go (controller mapping)
  • src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes.go (route registration: GET /exhibitions)
  • src/routes/v1/route.go (JWT exclusion rule verification)
  • src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes_test.go (route integration tests)
  • api-collection/Villume GO/Viewers/Get Published Exhibitions for Viewer.yml (API collection request)

API Specification

  • Endpoint: GET /v1/viewers/exhibitions
  • Method: GET
  • Authentication: Public
  • Query Parameters:
    • page (optional, default: 1): Current page number.
    • limit (optional, default: 12, max: 100): Items per page.
    • share_string (optional): Filter by exact share string.
    • search (optional): Search by exhibition name or artist name.
    • room (optional): Filter by room template name.
    • sort (optional, default: recently_published): recently_published, name_a_z, name_z_a.

Success Response (200 OK)

{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Success",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "name": "Dark Valleys",
        "thumbnail": "ALEXANDRIA/thumbnail.png",
        "share_string": "abc123xyz",
        "room_name": "Alexandria",
        "model_type": "Alexandria",
        "user": {
          "username": "georg_c2",
          "first_name": "Georg",
          "last_name": "Katstaller",
          "avatar": "https://villume.com/avatar.png"
        }
      }
    ],
    "total_count": 29,
    "total_pages": 3,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 12
  }
}

issues.display_title: Issue #220: Public API Artists Directory for Viewer
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Public API Artists Directory for Viewer

Files Changed / Added

  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerArtists.go (action handler with aggregation, filtering, search, sorting, and pagination)
  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerArtists_test.go (unit tests covering sorting, nil DB handling, and UUID exclusion verification)
  • src/controllers/v1/exhibitionController.go (controller mapping: GetViewerArtists)
  • src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes.go (route registration: viewers.Get("/artists", controllers.GetViewerArtists))
  • src/routes/v1/route.go (added OPTIONS:/v1/viewers/* to JWT exclusion rules)
  • src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes_test.go (route integration tests verifying unauthenticated access and OPTIONS preflight)
  • api-collection/Villume GO/Viewers/Get Artists for Viewer.yml (API collection request file)

Summary of Implementation

Implemented the public endpoint GET /v1/viewers/artists for the Villume VR / Web viewer:

  • Public unauthenticated access: Accessible without JWT token, matching viewer client requirements.
  • Total galleries count: Dynamically counts published, non-deleted exhibitions per artist (COUNT(exhibitions.id) via LEFT JOIN).
  • Optional galleries filter: Supports ?has_galleries=true to only return artists who have published at least one virtual gallery.
  • Search: Case-insensitive substring matching across users.username, users.first_name, users.last_name, and concatenated full name.
  • Sorting: Multi-column sorting supporting most_galleries (default), name_a_z, and name_z_a.
  • UUID exclusion: Omitted internal database id (UUID) from response payload as instructed, ensuring downstream integrations rely cleanly on username (GET /v1/users/:username and GET /v1/viewers/:username/exhibitions).

Detailed Changes

1. Action Handler (src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerArtists.go)

  • Query Parsing & Defaults:
    • page: default 1, validated > 0.
    • limit: default 12, max 100.
    • offset = (page - 1) * limit.
    • has_galleries: boolean check (true / 1).
  • Counting Query:
    • If has_galleries=true: Joins exhibitions with published = true AND deleted = false and performs Distinct("users.id").Count(&totalCount).
    • If default: Counts matching active user_type = 'user' accounts.
  • Aggregation Query: 
    dataQuery := config.DB.WithContext(c.Context()).
    Table("users").
    Select("users.username, users.first_name, users.last_name, users.avatar, COUNT(exhibitions.id) AS total_galleries").
    Joins("LEFT JOIN exhibitions ON exhibitions.user_id = users.id AND exhibitions.published = ? AND exhibitions.deleted = ?", true, false).
    Where("users.is_active = ? AND users.user_type = ?", true, "user")
  • Sorting (ResolveViewerArtistOrder):
    • most_galleries (default): COUNT(exhibitions.id) DESC, users.first_name ASC, users.id ASC
    • name_a_z: users.first_name ASC, users.last_name ASC, users.id ASC
    • name_z_a: users.first_name DESC, users.last_name DESC, users.id DESC
  • Response Construction:
    Constructs ViewerArtistItem omitting id: 
    type ViewerArtistItem struct {
    Username       string  `json:"username"        gorm:"column:username"`
    FirstName      string  `json:"first_name"      gorm:"column:first_name"`
    LastName       string  `json:"last_name"       gorm:"column:last_name"`
    Avatar         *string `json:"avatar"          gorm:"column:avatar"`
    TotalGalleries int64   `json:"total_galleries" gorm:"column:total_galleries"`
}

2. Route Configuration (src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes.go)

viewers := r.Group("/viewers")
viewers.Get("/exhibitions", controllers.GetViewerPublishedExhibitions)
viewers.Get("/artists", controllers.GetViewerArtists)
...

Registered before /:username/exhibitions to avoid any route ambiguity.

3. API Collection

Added api-collection/Villume GO/Viewers/Get Artists for Viewer.yml.

API Usage & Examples (How to Use)

1. Default Listing (Artists Directory & Highlighted Artists)

Fetches artists sorted by most_galleries (artists with the most published galleries appear first):

curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/artists?page=1&limit=12"

2. Filter Only Artists with Published Galleries

Only return artists who currently have at least 1 published gallery (total_galleries > 0):

curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/artists?has_galleries=true&page=1&limit=12"

3. Search by Artist Name or Username

Search for artists by first name, last name, full name, or username:

curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/artists?search=Georg%20Katstaller"

4. Custom Sorting (Alphabetical A-Z / Z-A)

# Sort artists by name A-Z
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/artists?sort=name_a_z&page=1&limit=12"

# Sort artists by name Z-A
curl -X GET "{{base_url}}/v1/viewers/artists?sort=name_z_a&page=1&limit=12"

5. Example JSON Response

{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Success",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "username": "georg_c2",
        "first_name": "Georg",
        "last_name": "Katstaller",
        "avatar": "https://villume.com/avatar.png",
        "total_galleries": 4
      }
    ],
    "total_count": 48,
    "total_pages": 4,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 12
  }
}

6. Downstream Client Integration Flow

When a user clicks on an artist card in artists.html or the VR carousel:

  1. Fetch Profile Details: Use item.username to call GET /v1/users/:username (bio, social links, location, etc.).
  2. Fetch Artist's Published Galleries: Use item.username to call GET /v1/viewers/:username/exhibitions?type=outside.
  3. No database UUID is required at any point in the viewer flow.

Verification & Tests

Automated Tests

  1. src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerArtists_test.go:
    • TestResolveViewerArtistOrder: Verifies sorting clauses for all options.
    • TestGetViewerArtists_NilDB: Verifies graceful failure when database is unavailable.
    • TestViewerArtistItem_NoUUIDInJSON: Explicitly asserts that id and uuid are not serialized in the response JSON.
  2. src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes_test.go:
    • TestViewerRoutesArePublic: Verifies GET /v1/viewers/artists does not require JWT authorization.
    • TestViewerRoutesOptionsPreflight: Verifies OPTIONS preflight requests succeed without auth.

Overview

Implement the public endpoint GET /v1/viewers/artists to support the Artists Directory and the Highlighted Artists carousel for the Villume VR / Web viewer client (artists.html).

The endpoint provides:

  1. Paginated artist directory listing (page and limit).
  2. Search by artist name or username (?search=...).
  3. Count of published galleries per artist (total_galleries).
  4. Optional filter to list only artists who have active published galleries (?has_galleries=true).
  5. Multi-option sorting (most_galleries, name_a_z, name_z_a).
  6. Excludes internal database UUIDs (id) as downstream viewer endpoints rely exclusively on username (GET /v1/users/:username and GET /v1/viewers/:username/exhibitions).

Requirements

  1. Public Access:
    • Endpoint is unauthenticated (no JWT token required).
    • Exempt from JWT middleware under /v1/viewers/*.
  2. Filtering & Visibility:
    • Only active user accounts (users.is_active = true) with user_type = 'user' are considered artists (excludes support/admin accounts).
    • total_galleries represents the count of published, non-deleted exhibitions owned by the artist (published = true AND deleted = false).
    • Supports ?has_galleries=true to filter out users with 0 published galleries.
  3. Search:
    • Supports ?search=... performing case-insensitive matching across users.username, users.first_name, users.last_name, and concatenated full name.
  4. Sorting (?sort=...):
    • most_galleries (default): COUNT(exhibitions.id) DESC, users.first_name ASC, users.id ASC
    • name_a_z: users.first_name ASC, users.last_name ASC, users.id ASC
    • name_z_a: users.first_name DESC, users.last_name DESC, users.id DESC
  5. Pagination:
    • page: integer (default: 1, minimum: 1).
    • limit: integer (default: 12, max: 100).
    • Response includes total_count, total_pages, page, and limit.
  6. Data Contract:
    • items: Array of artist objects containing username, first_name, last_name, avatar, and total_galleries.
    • Does not expose database UUID (id), as subsequent artist detail calls use username.
    • Returns empty array [] (not null) when no records match.

Scope

  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerArtists.go (handler logic, aggregation, filtering, sorting, pagination)
  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getViewerArtists_test.go (unit tests)
  • src/controllers/v1/exhibitionController.go (controller mapping)
  • src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes.go (route registration: GET /artists)
  • src/routes/v1/route.go (JWT exclusion rule verification)
  • src/routes/v1/viewerRoutes_test.go (route integration tests)
  • api-collection/Villume GO/Viewers/Get Artists for Viewer.yml (API collection request)

API Specification

  • Endpoint: GET /v1/viewers/artists
  • Method: GET
  • Authentication: Public
  • Query Parameters:
    • page (optional, default: 1): Current page number.
    • limit (optional, default: 12, max: 100): Items per page.
    • search (optional): Search by artist name or username.
    • has_galleries (optional): true to return only artists who have published galleries.
    • sort (optional, default: most_galleries): most_galleries, name_a_z, name_z_a.

Success Response (200 OK)

{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Success",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      {
        "username": "georg_c2",
        "first_name": "Georg",
        "last_name": "Katstaller",
        "avatar": "https://villume.com/avatar.png",
        "total_galleries": 4
      }
    ],
    "total_count": 48,
    "total_pages": 4,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 12
  }
}
